Make exactly EIGHT isolated, entire, RIGHT-facing figures regularly laid out in a four column by two row grid, generous clear gutters including outermost edges. True transparent background; no floor/shadow/FX/text/labels. Ref 2 is skeletal choreography only; ref 3 is an approved male character animation for rhythm and leg ordering ONLY, do not adopt his wardrobe or face. Same scale, camera, lighting and model across all frames. Outlines clean like the identity reference. Same serious expression as idle. Draw near anatomical RIGHT leg and arm in light, far LEFT leg slightly darker and behind it when they overlap. Upper body in three-quarter right-facing profile, face to screen right. Cloth and hair lag smoothly. Never repeat the same leg leading in both rows. For the very FIRST CEL of row TWO, the entire lighter near thigh from the visible hip to the knee extends BACK towards SCREEN LEFT and connects to the rear shoe; the darker far leg leads forward to screen RIGHT. Do not duplicate the top row. Each row must depict different near-leg silhouette and occlusions at the hip. Two half cycles with precisely equal and opposite stride and knee lift. Guarded upright WALK cycle. Top row: near/right leg stepping forward onto heel with far leg stretched back on toe; next near leg flat under weight, dark far shoe lifting behind; then near leg straight under pelvis, far knee bent passing it; finally far leg swinging forward and near leg behind. Bottom row opposite: FAR/left thigh and shoe forward on heel in the first pose, right/near leg stretching backward with near/right foot visibly behind, near arm forward. Follow with loading, passing, opposite foot swing. A continuous cycle where eighth frame leads back to first. In contact poses toe-to-toe span about 31% of standing height. Pelvis stays fixed, support foot moves uniformly backwards. His heavy coat must sway gently behind him and uncover the heels. Carry both massive gauntlets no lower than the knees and keep both far and near feet independently visible at passing.
